senses.gloss:
शृध् शृध्, i. 1, Ātm., and in the aor., fut., and condit. also Par. To fart.
 --i. 1, Par. Ātm. † To wet, to moisten.
 --i. 10, To insult (by breaking wind against, or by defiling with excrements).
 --With the prep. अव अव, To break wind against somebody, Man. 8, 282.
 --Cf. शकृत्.
शृधू शृध् + ऊ, f. The anus.
